description: This source file implements the DU Ue Controller logic, including RLF detection handling, adapter classes for MAC and RLC notifications, and UE activity management functions.

classes.name: mac_rlf_du_adapter
classes.description: Adapter class for MAC RLF notifications, triggers RLF handling in DU manager.

classes.name: rlc_rlf_du_adapter
classes.description: Adapter class for RLC RLF notifications, dispatches RLF detection to DU manager executor.

classes.name: du_ue_controller_impl::rlf_state_machine
classes.description: State machine managing RLF detection, timer, and UE release logic.

methods.name: get_rlf_cause_str
methods.description: Converts rlf_cause enum to string description.

methods.name: handle_rlf_detection
methods.description: Handles RLF detection event, starts timer, and manages UE release.

methods.name: handle_crnti_ce_detection
methods.description: Handles C-RNTI C/E reception, potentially resets RLF timer.

methods.name: get_release_timeout
methods.description: Calculates RLF release timeout based on UE timers.

methods.name: trigger_ue_release
methods.description: Triggers UE release request upon RLF timer expiry.

methods.name: handle_activity_stop_request
methods.description: Handles request to stop UE activity and disables RLF detection.

methods.name: handle_rb_stop_request
methods.description: Stops all or subset of bearers (DRBs and SRBs).

methods.name: run_in_ue_executor
methods.description: Dispatches a task to run within the UE control executor context.
